2.
The petitioners are aggrieved by the non payment of compensation in spite of the acquisition of their lands under the National Highway Authority Act, 1956 (in short ' the Act, 1956).

3. The Notification under Section 3 A was published on 29.12.2023,Notification under Section 3 D was published on 18.3.2024 and the amount of the compensation was determined by the competent authority on 3.7.2024.

sentences.text: 4. Learned Standing Counsel says that yesterday i.e. 9.1.2025 a cheque of Rs. 30,46,066/- has been sent to the Axis Bank for disbursement of the said amount to the petitioners as compensation.
A written instruction in this regard received by the learned Standing Counsel is taken on record.
5. A photo copy of cheque has already been provided to the petitioners' counsel along with other documents.

6. The competent authority/Special Land Acquisition Officer shall furnish petitioners wise details of the amount to the Bank for payment to the petitioners with the required break-up, if any, within one week.

If the petitioners have any further grievance, they can approach the Court again, however, for the moment, we see no reason as to why they would not actually receive money in their accounts as aforesaid.
7. With the aforesaid observations/direction, the writ petition is disposed of.
[Rajan Roy, J.] Order Date :- 10.1.2025 / Anuj Singh  Anuj Kumar Singh And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl Chief Secy. ...
